# SelectionController

> Manages single or multi-select item state with Ctrl/Shift modifiers, dispatching `ui-selection-change`.

## Constructor

```ts
new SelectionController(host: HTMLElement, options?: SelectionOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `selector` | `string` | yes |  |
| `mode` | `'single' | 'multiple'` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-selection-change` | `{ selected, count }` |

## Methods

| Method |
|--------|
| `destroy()` |
| `select()` |
| `toggle()` |
| `rangeTo()` |
| `selectAll()` |
| `clear()` |
| `getSelection()` |
| `handleClick()` |

## Usage

```ts
import { SelectionController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new SelectionController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
